data.title: True or False Equation Detectives
data.description: Learn what the equal sign really means by looking at equations and deciding if they show the exact same amount on both sides.

challenges.instruction: Does this equation show the same amount on both sides? Let's check if it is true or false!
Look closely at this equation. Do both sides match, or is something wrong?
Count carefully! Is this balanced math sentence true or false?
Let's test this equation. Does the left side equal the right side?
Here is our final challenge! Is this equation telling the truth?
